basic_info.description: Charming and quiet 2bd/2ba condo in desirable Oceanview Terrace community. The unit features hardwood floors, new carpet, updated bathrooms, and new stainless-steel appliances. The primary bedroom suite boasts a deck overlooking the surrounding area and a spacious closet with functional shelving. Washer and dryer in unit. One car parking in gated garage. Amazing locale atop shopping, dining, banking and more! Close to theatres, freeway access, BART and minutes from downtown San Francisco and San Mateo.
